findings.evidence: `Discriminant.lean:61` provides `QuadraticForm.discr_atRealPlace`; this file instead unfolds `discrAtRealPlace` directly at line 171.
findings.fix: Add a public `globalInvariants_discrAtRealPlace` lemma identifying it with the discriminant of `Q.atRealPlace w`, using `discr_atRealPlace`, and mark it `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: `globalInvariants` characterizes its finite localized discriminant but not the parallel real localized discriminant, forcing consumers to unfold `GlobalFormInvariants.discrAtRealPlace`.

findings.evidence: Lines 86, 91, 98, and 103 tag every direct projection lemma `@[simp]`, while lines 110 and 119 omit the attribute despite having equally canonical orientations.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to both lemmas so derived projections of `globalInvariants` normalize without explicit unfolding or rewrite lists.
findings.issue: The canonical normal-form lemmas `globalInvariants_discrAtFinitePlace` and `globalInvariants_realNegativeIndex` (line 119) are not tagged `@[simp]`, unlike all four direct projections.

summary: The characteristic API omits the real-place discriminant projection, and two canonical projection lemmas lack normal-form automation.
